descriptions.title: Sets the document title.
descriptions.subtitle: Sets a document subtitle.
descriptions.tempo: Sets the tempo in beats per minute.
descriptions.meta: Sets a supported metadata field and value.
descriptions.comment: Displays a comment in the chart.
descriptions.commentBox: Displays a boxed comment in the chart.
descriptions.commentItalic: Displays an italic comment in the chart.
descriptions.highlight: Displays highlighted text in the chart.
descriptions.chorus: Displays a chorus recall marker with an optional label.
descriptions.startVerse: Starts a verse and adds its matching end directive.
descriptions.startChorus: Starts a chorus and adds its matching end directive.
descriptions.startBridge: Starts a bridge and adds its matching end directive.
descriptions.startTab: Starts a tablature block and adds its matching end directive.
descriptions.startGrid: Starts a jazz grid and adds its matching end directive.
descriptions.startAbc: Starts an ABC notation block and adds its matching end directive.
descriptions.endAbc: Ends the current ABC notation block.
descriptions.startTextblock: Starts a text block and adds its matching end directive.
descriptions.columns: Sets the number of layout columns.
descriptions.column: Moves following content to the selected column.
descriptions.columnBreak: Moves following content to the next column.
descriptions.transpose: Transposes following chords; an empty value restores the previous amount.
descriptions.diagrams: Controls chord diagram placement and visibility.
descriptions.chord: Displays one chord diagram at this position.
descriptions.image: Displays a safe HTTP or HTTPS image.
